problem: The function $P(t)=710\operatorname{ln}⁡(1+{e}^{t})$ represents the volume of milk, in liters, produced on a farm $t$ days after the owner bought new cows. What is the instantaneous rate of change of the volume of produced milk as a function of $t?$

feedback.problem:
The number of views $V,$ in millions, of a viral video after $t$ days is modeled by $V(t)=\frac{{10}^{t}}{\operatorname{ln}⁡10}$ for $0\le t\le 6.$ What is the instantaneous rate of change of the number of views as a function of $t?$

The instantaneous rate of change is
{{field-1}} views per day.
feedback.worked_solution:
The instantaneous rate of change of the number of views is equal to ${V}^{′}(t).$ 

First, we take the derivative and get

$$
\begin{aligned}{V}^{′}(t) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(\frac{{10}^{t}}{\operatorname{ln}⁡10}) \\  & =\frac{{10}^{t}\cdot \operatorname{ln}⁡10}{\operatorname{ln}⁡10} \\  & ={10}^{t}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the instantaneous rate of change of the number of views is ${10}^{t}.$
